designationHistory.name: Medicine Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established Aug. 19, 1935, as the Medicine Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7148, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Medicine Lake National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7148, signed Aug. 19, 1935
Federal Register: Medicine Lake NWR final CCP notice, Feb. 20, 2008 (established 1935 by EO 7148)
FWS ServCat: Medicine Lake NWR Complex CCP (timeline: 1935 refuge established)

review.note: Wrong year: FWS page says 1936; EO 7148 is dated Aug. 19, 1935. (The FR CCP notice prints "August 29, 1935", out of sequence with EOs 7142 of Aug. 14 and 7154-A of Aug. 22; the APP text shows Aug. 19.)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Established in 1936, with the primary purpose of preserving and enhancing resting, feeding, and breeding habitat for migratory birds and other wildlife, this 15,551-acre refuge contains numerous wetlands.
